findings: Contents pp468-471 identifies cab description at p170, heater p172, bodywork p173 and steering starting p178. No separately named lower-step assembly/repair subsection appears in these inspected contents pages.

The maintenance table has a chassis/cabs section at rows 50-63, spanning pp366-370. It covers wheels/tires, suspension/frame, special-body supports, sun visor and wipers. These inspected rows do not specify lower-step mounting, a step part number, support section/material, hidden hardpoint, rear endpoint or wheel clearance.
Row 62 concerns special-body support nuts for 543A/543V/543M. It is not a lower-step support instruction and its listed wrench sizes must not be adopted for the step.
No new lower-step geometry or support material was established. The previously inspected pp170-177 and figure 2 were not re-decoded or re-reviewed in this pass.

photo_findings.claim: Left-cab lower frame and three descending supports are visible. Its rear end is close to the first tire front outline in this oblique image. The rear door extends over the first-wheel upper/front region in projection.
photo_findings.boundary: Projection only. No exact longitudinal end, lateral position, distance, first-wheel envelope or target-A applicability follows.

photo_findings.claim: The three visible supports do not provide resolved upper attachment fasteners or section detail. Their bent/irregular appearance is observable.
photo_findings.boundary: Do not infer cable, hose, solid rod, steel, rubber, flexibility or joints from this limited image.

photo_findings.claim: The right-cab below-sill structure does not show the same complete suspended lower frame seen on the left; thin hanging elements and a different visible horizontal member are present.
photo_findings.boundary: Possible incomplete/damaged condition is an interpretation, not a confirmed diagnosis. Absence or asymmetry in these photos is not original design evidence.

photo_findings.claim: Rear views show the chassis and cabs but do not resolve the lower-step upper attachments.
photo_findings.boundary: No step measurements or mounting conclusions derived.

new_custodial_source_lead.potential_next_check: If a physical-document inquiry is later authorized, request the AT 278 catalog card/identification plate and relevant operating-log repair entries first. Verify A applicability and original step condition before requesting close views or a measured survey.
